title: Catalog
description: Categories and tags organize the offers and are what students filter by.
name: Name

categories.title: Categories
categories.hint: Every offer has one. An inactive category cannot be chosen for new offers nor used as a filter; offers that already have it keep it.

tags.title: Tags
tags.hint: Optional labels for offers, such as technologies or languages.
tags.deleteText_zero: "{{name}}" will be deleted. No offer uses it.
tags.deleteText_one: "{{name}}" will be deleted and removed from the offer that uses it.
tags.deleteText_other: "{{name}}" will be deleted and removed from the {{count}} offers that use it.
